description: SecurityInsight_Trend -- launcher for the asset-trend engine (daily trend rollup).
notes: Invokes engine/asset-trend/Invoke-SITrend.ps1. Reads the Risk Analysis results in the workspace and publishes SI_Trend_CL, a narrow daily table kept for years. Schedule it LAST, once per day, after Risk Analysis. Customer config layered: LauncherConfig.defaults.ps1 -> SecurityInsight.custom.ps1 (config) -> LauncherConfig.custom.ps1 -> CLI args.
author: Morten Knudsen (Invardia) <info@invardia.com>
